notes.title: New Update: NPCs Are Here! The City Comes to Life 🌭🏙️
notes.notes:
[b]Big news, chefs!
[/b]We're bringing Street Chef - Food Seller Simulator one step closer to a living, breathing (and hungry) city with our latest update. Here's what's new on the streets:


[b]🧍‍♂️ NPC Behaviors Added
[/b]The city now feels alive! NPCs will now sunbathe, chat, run, and go about their daily lives—bringing more energy and immersion to your hotdog-selling hustle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45349762/389d3ad729e92cd53fb696e361fe438980e6b491.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45349762/c2bfabdb79a3c8546f55dd03aeea48edd10b8b33.png[/img]

[b]🌭 NPC Order System Implemented
[/b]NPCs can now walk order hotdogs from your cart! Get ready to serve a variety of customers with different cravings and personalities. Don’t keep them waiting!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45349762/d7878d29825a2404e2a385c66533c496b51cbbfe.png[/img]

[b]🎭 Different NPC Models for Diversity
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45349762/d6a4f6635acbbbe0ac9b8ec04d2b790cbb240acc.png[/img]


Get out there, fire up the grill, and serve the city!

Let us know what you think about these changes—we're always cooking up more features based on your feedback. 🔥

notes.title: New Features: Order System, Toppings, and a New Hotdog Bun!
notes.notes:
[b]Order System: 
[/b]
Now you can order your ingredients directly via the tablet! Order what you need and pick it up from the delivery point to keep your hotdog cart stocked and ready to serve.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45349762/44aad69363bc0268e1f9ff420894a3afbe2f041e.jpg[/img]


[b]Hotdog Toppings
[/b]
Customize your creations with pickles, onion, chili, and cheese for even more tasty combinations.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45349762/729d6d813415f1a683c78f6b14d3b3f3ef4a9bed.jpg[/img]

[b]New Hotdog Bun
[/b]
New French hotdog bun is now available!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45349762/108fdd4089c6049c21531ae1cd3b09a454ab691b.jpg[/img]

notes.title: New Feature: Garage 🎨🔥
notes.notes:
You can now customize your cart to match your style and grow your hotdog business!

[b]What Can You Customize?[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Stickers[/b] – Show off your personality with unique decals!
[*] [b]Signboards[/b] – Make your cart stand out with catchy signs!
[*] [b]Accessories[/b] – Add flair with fun props!
[*] [b]Wheels[/b] – Upgrade your wheels for a smoother ride!
[*] [b]Extra Storage[/b] – Carry more ingredients, serve more customers!
[*] [b]Horns[/b] – Honk your way through the streets!
[*] [b]Lighting[/b] – Brighten up your cart and attract more customers at night!
[/list]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45349762/f5fc37f819e66b88d86630cc4662f80ebcfdb8da.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45349762/f5fc37f819e66b88d86630cc4662f80ebcfdb8da.gif[/img][/url]

notes.title: NEW GAME MECHANIC: RIDE YOUR HOTDOG CART! 🌭🔥
notes.notes:
We’ve added a brand-new mechanic to Hotdog Simulator—you can now push your cart! 🚶‍♂️🔥
Need to find a better spot? Just grab the handles and start moving!

🔹 Relocate your cart to find the best customers!
🔹 Navigate through busy streets and sell your delicious hotdogs anywhere you want!
🔹 More cart upgrades & interactions coming soon!

See the video and let us know what you think! 🚀
[previewyoutube=oGvByCRr3qg;full][/previewyoutube]
